summary: Gallery item DELETE feature verified end-to-end on production preview (desktop 1920x1080). Admin login -> Profile -> My Gallery -> open item modal -> Delete button visible -> Cancel dismisses confirmation with modal still open -> Delete + Confirm triggers DELETE /api/gallery/{id}, success toast 'Gallery item deleted' appears, modal closes, item is removed from grid (empty state returns), and after full page reload the item does NOT reappear (soft-delete persisted). No 'Not authenticated' error anywhere.

critical_code_review_comments: Gallery thumbnail hover overlay in GalleryGrid intercepts pointer events for images on desktop; the parent card still handles clicks, but adding pointer-events-none to the overlay div would improve testability and prevent edge-case click misses.
GalleryItemModal.handleDelete correctly uses withCredentials:true; token is also attached via the axios default Authorization header set by AuthContext, so both cookie and Bearer paths work.
canDelete logic in Gallery.js (owner OR admin OR moderator) matches backend rule in /app/backend/routes/gallery.py delete_gallery_item — no client/server mismatch.
Minor: onDelete callback in Gallery.js closes the modal via setSelectedItem(null) AND the modal itself also calls onClose — redundant but not harmful.
